judged_text: The rss.items loop has no per-item error isolation, so the first item that raises — a missing title making PostCreator/TopicEmbed.create! fail on a NOT NULL column, a nil link, or ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique from the check-then-insert in TopicEmbed.import when the scheduled poll and a retriever-triggered poll run concurrently — aborts the entire loop. One malformed feed entry stops import of every remaining feed item until it ages out of the feed, and because TopicRetriever invokes this poll synchronously the same exception also kills retrieval for every embed URL, leaving those pages reloading the loading view forever.

adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, the code iterates `rss.items.each` and directly calls `TopicEmbed.import(...)` without any `rescue`/per-item isolation. Any exception raised while processing one item (e.g., from `TopicEmbed.import`/`PostCreator#create`/`TopicEmbed.create!` or a uniqueness violation on `topic_embeds.embed_url`) will abort the entire loop and fail the job. This is exacerbated by `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously, so an exception in feed polling can also prevent embed retrieval from progressing.
